jobs.name: 含章剑
jobs.prompt: One complete standalone inventory object for a Chinese cultivation RPG. Image 1 is the USER APPROVED PORCELAIN BOTTLE STYLE REFERENCE, not the subject to copy unless the subject is a bottle. Match its hand-painted watercolor texture and believable painted volume, while keeping this object's own material and local colors. Chinese ink and restrained watercolor, thin varied grey-brown contours, low-saturation pigments, subtle directional brushwork following the form. Quiet matte surfaces under broad diffuse illumination. Solid volume through gently separated light, middle and shadow planes of the LOCAL COLOR. Lighter strokes are muted pigment on the object, never reflected light spots. Clear silhouette and few readable material features for small inventory display. No self-emission, bloom, aura, halo, rim lighting, white edge streaks, specular hotspots, sparkles, glossy reflections, glassy droplets, plastic or frosted 3D rendering. No flat vector shapes, thick cartoon outline, photographic noise or dense tiny scratches. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY outside the physical silhouette; no backdrop, floor, cast shadow, frame, lettering or interface. Exactly ONE complete object, fully inside canvas with about 6 percent even safe margin. Never reproduce the brown/black preview background of the reference. Subject: 含章剑, a functional Chinese straight sword with a strong central longitudinal RIDGE separating two broad solid grey bevel planes. A long pointed double-edged blade, a simple aged jade-bronze crossguard with a shallow angular Greek-key shape, dark charcoal cord-wrapped cylindrical grip and modest faceted bronze pommel. FULLY VERTICAL, blade tip up, grip down, straight orthographic front view. Repaint all steel surfaces in MEDIUM NEUTRAL GREY local colors: main blade pigment approximately #7b807a, light plane #92958a, shadow #565d5d. ALL BLADE PLANES REMAIN MID-GREY. A softly painted dull iron surface with broad quiet values, NOT polished steel. Do not paint any white, cream, ivory or near-white areas anywhere on the blade. No long white strip, no white cutting edge, no white point or glint; blade ridge and cutting edges are simply darker adjacent grey surfaces. Entire sword tip, blade, guard, grip and pommel inside frame. No gems, magic effects, inscriptions, ornamentation, tassels, scabbard, extra swords or props. Final grid footprint 3x6, portrait canvas aspect 3:6. Preserve the whole straight sword, no diagonal angle or foreshortening, modest even safe transparent margin.
